description: Your own already-published posts with their engagement counters — views, likes, comments, shares, saves, impressions, format, platform, post date — and engagementPerView, (likes + comments + shares + saves) / views: rank on that rate rather than on views. No reach, watch time or follower counts are available. This is the raw performance history, not an interpretation of it; pair with growth_brief for that. No cost to call. Use when the user asks how their own published posts performed.

appId.description: Your product's id. Omit only with a single-app workspace.

engagementPerView.description: (likes + comments + shares + saves) / views; null with no views. Rank on this, not on views.
